policy: Dated first-party research for Day 3 (16 October 2026), not a live pricing feed and never a replacement for the automated picks pipeline. day_two_results.read: The rebuilt Aurora side reset after the Day 1 upset: a controlled 2-0 over NiP keeps them alive and eliminates NiP (0-2). This is the first verified sign that the Day 1 loss has not collapsed the team — it lowers, but does not remove, the roster-integration discount from the Day 1 review.

day_two_results.read: 9z lost the series but took Mirage 13-8 off Falcons and reached nine rounds on both other maps. The Day 1 result was therefore not a one-map fluke: 9z are competitive against the group winner. Falcons finish 2-0 and take the Group A semi-final slot.

day_two_results.read: BetBoom survive after losing their pick-adjacent opener map: they closed Anubis and Mirage convincingly after PARIVISION took Ancient. PARIVISION are eliminated (0-2). BetBoom's Day 1 pattern — strong starts, shaky closing, documented in HLTV's day-one report — is partly answered, but against the weakest remaining Group B side.

day_three.guidance: Primary: Aurora (69.5% Polymarket / 69.2% Kalshi). Contrarian candidate (the designated Day 3 leaderboard flip): 9z (30.5% Polymarket / 30.8% Kalshi). Evidence for the flip: 9z beat this exact rebuilt Aurora lineup 2-0 on Day 1 (13-11 Inferno, 13-1 Nuke, HLTV match 2399384), permanently ban Aurora's 75% Anubis map, and beat group winners Falcons 13-8 on Mirage on Day 2 (raising 9z's 3-month Mirage winrate to 67% vs Aurora's 62%). Evidence against the flip: Aurora reset with a 2-0 over NiP on Day 2 (Cache 13-9, Dust2 13-7) and hold 69.5% / 69.2% across two independent exchanges. Use 9z only when trailing on the leaderboard; protecting a lead means staying with Aurora.

day_three.guidance: Primary: Legacy (63.5% Polymarket / 63.6% Kalshi). Keep Legacy as a chalk anchor rather than flipping to BETBOOM (36.5%). Structural veto reason from HLTV match 2399413: Legacy permanently bans Anubis first in every TWC series (0 maps played in 3 months, removed step 2 in both 2399386 and 2399411), which removes the exact map (Anubis 13-4 vs PARIVISION) that drove BetBoom's Day 2 survival. Meanwhile BetBoom permanently bans Inferno (0 maps in 3 months), leaving Legacy ahead across Nuke (80% vs 50%), Mirage (73% vs 43%), Ancient (55% vs 25%), and Dust2 (54% vs 1 map). If you want one Day 3 contrarian swing, take 9z (30.5%) in Group A and anchor with Legacy (63.5%) in Group B.
